openings.claim: Construction candidate: separate seating from restraint. Plywood corner datums and axial stops locate each rod before hand-operated M5 pressure members clamp it against datums; cord tethers movable members/nuts, loops retain them. This replaces tight enclosing clearance, which may restrain yet trap rods before stop contact; performance is unproven.
openings.discriminator: If incomplete seating caused the supplied tighter-fit reversal, datum-first should reduce unloaded return error versus enclosing contact. Tightening may improve loaded stability without improving return error. Equal seating with similar return weakens this explanation. The 18 mm substitution may reveal centerline/pointer-offset dependence despite repeatable face seating.
openings.probe: Use supplied materials/tools only: six plywood pieces, eight M5 bolts/nuts, four washers, loops and cord. Within 100 fabrication minutes, make one reversible fixture with corner/stop and optional enclosing contact. Verify captive parts, hand-only assembly/adjustment, access, achievable fastening geometry, 90 mm cube envelope; no rod drilling/adhesive/permanent marks. Compare two configurations: five exchanges per original rod, then two 18 mm substitutions each; log duration (under forty seconds required)/unloaded error. Four ten-second 10 N load trials each: initial, fifth exchange of each original rod, final substitution; record escape from 2 mm target. At forty seconds/exchange, only 160 seconds remain for switching/load setup/logging in twenty testing minutes; infeasibility leaves comparison unresolved.
openings.uncertainty: Declared fit uncertain: required rod orientation/pointer attachment are unspecified; fixed-face suitability, subdivisions, stiff captive pressure members and fabrication feasibility require verification. Two adverse trials suggest seating without establishing cause. Defeat: inconsistent stop contact, crushing, slip, angular amplification beyond 2 mm, substitution offset, free components or exchanges exceeding forty seconds. Full loaded-return outcome remains unproven.

lineage.reason: Retained causal relation, rival, predictions, constraints, uncertainty and complete probe/defeat conditions.

decision: Retain for investigation only if construction and timing are realizable. No deployment follows.
